tasks.personal-social-wellbeing-t1: Topic: Personal and Social Well-being. Cover self-image, personal strengths, healthy habits, peer pressure, respect, simple goal setting, refusal skills, and supportive friendships. Ask learners to choose healthy responses in everyday scenarios, identify respectful behaviour, recognise positive self-talk, or decide how to resist unsafe peer pressure.
tasks.physical-education-t1: Topic: Physical Education. Cover warm-ups, locomotor and non-locomotor movement, balance, coordination, target games, aiming, throwing accuracy, safety routines, and teamwork. Ask learners to identify correct movement types, choose safe class behaviours, or decide which skill best improves balance and target-game performance.
tasks.creative-arts-t1: Topic: Creative Arts. Cover line, shape, colour, simple 2D artwork, rhythm, steady beat, body percussion, drama games, and movement phrases. Ask learners to identify art elements, choose how rhythm patterns work, recognise body percussion actions, or decide which drama activity best shows an idea or feeling.
